summary: Iteration 2: V2 supervisor graph, human-in-the-loop approval, opt-out, quiet-hours, simulation/eval — all verified end-to-end. Backend pytest: 8/8 state machine + 11/12 new v2 API tests pass (1 skipped is expected: the reject-test depends on a HOT lead being in pending_approval, but the earlier approve-test resumed the only available one; test asserts skip rather than false-fail). Frontend: approval banner + approve/reject buttons + opt-out banner + source badges + /compare page all render and behave correctly.

minor.issue: FastAPI on_event('shutdown') is deprecated in favour of lifespan handlers — warning only, not blocking.

issues: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Traced to a dev-tool injected wrapper (data-ve-dynamic='true') on <option> children. Not visible to users but pollutes console. Fix by rendering plain text child in the <select><option> loop (e.g., `{`${l.name} — ${l.status} (${l.score})`}` without wrapping spans).

action_items: OPTIONAL: switch @app.on_event('shutdown') to FastAPI lifespan handler to silence deprecation.
OPTIONAL: strip dev-inject <span> from <option> to remove console hydration warning on /compare.
critical_code_review_comments: Supervisor trace merging in run_supervisor uses `[s for s in state.get('trace',[]) if s not in existing]` which relies on dict equality — works but O(n*m); consider a fingerprint set once trace history grows.
server.py is 982 lines — approaching the 700-line refactor threshold. Extract Providers, State-machine + endpoints into modules soon.
NotificationProvider.send accepts either a Lead model or a dict but only uses .id — signature is slightly ambiguous; type it as Union[Lead, dict] and normalize once.
graph.py checkpointer stores raw dict `state` under Mongo `_id=<lead_id>`; there is no schema version — future graph changes will fail to load older checkpoints. Add a `version` field.
seed_data_creation: Simulation endpoint created 15 sim-* leads (Sim Alpha..Oscar). Plus ~10 TEST_-prefixed leads from CRUD tests. Reset via DELETE /api/reset if cleanup needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest.ini enforces `-n 2 --dist loadscope` — override with `-n 0` for serial runs. Force HOT leads by scanning existing DB before creating new ones (LLM ~25% picks the $1.2M cash-buyer script). The escalate node is idempotent-with-approval: first call sets _interrupt=True; approve/reject re-invokes with approved flag and the escalate node runs a SECOND time.
verified_flows: POST /api/leads/{id}/supervisor -> trace has load_history + supervisor + action steps (>=3)
POST /api/leads/{id}/approve -> escalate runs 2nd time with 'Human approved escalation' in trace, pending_approval flips false
POST /api/leads/{id}/opt-out -> opted_out=true, blocks future notifier.send (event kind=followup meta.blocked=opted_out)
Google Ads webhook: 401 bad key, 422 missing fields, 200 lead_id valid payload
State-machine guardrail: POST /api/leads/{id}/book while CALLING -> 400 Illegal transition
Frontend LeadDetail: approval-banner + btn-approve-escalation + btn-reject-escalation + opted-out-banner + btn-opt-out all render and function
Frontend Dashboard: source badge chip (sim / google-ads-test / seed) on non-web leads
Frontend /compare: V1 rules panel + V2 supervisor panel with Run Supervisor button both render
